full_prompt_en: A square, finely finished oil portrait shows a pale young sitter from the chest upward against a deep brown-black studio ground. The background is almost empty, with only a faint warm halo on the right separating the near shoulder from the darkness. The sitter occupies the center and turns the upper body slightly toward the right while looking directly at the viewer. A broad cream fabric hat fills the upper part of the image. Its low curved brim is edged in beige, and layered lace or embroidered flowers spread across the crown in pale relief. Soft, powdery blond hair curls out beneath the brim on both sides and gathers into loose ringlets near the neck. The face is oval and gently illuminated, with clear brown eyes, a small nose, lightly blushed cheeks, and a slight closed smile. The gaze is steady but relaxed, and the chin is delicately rounded. A white scarf or neckcloth folds at the throat and descends beneath a richly textured lace collar. Fine pale loops along that collar stand out against the dark green garment. The bodice extends across the lower half, with shallow vertical fabric lines and a narrow central opening or fastening. The sleeves and outer shoulders remain mostly cropped by the square frame. No hands or props are visible. Skin, lace, hair, and dress are all modeled with controlled small strokes, yet their surfaces read differently: smooth flesh, airy curls, raised lace, and matte cloth. The dark background and tight crop keep attention on the calm facial features and the frame of pale hat and collar. Soft light seems to arrive from the upper left and front, brightening the forehead, nose, cheeks, and hat brim while leaving the side of the neck and right shoulder in gentle shade. The overall composition is poised and harmonious, balancing luminous cream and warm skin against deep green and brown shadow in a quiet formal study.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、完成度精细的油画肖像呈现一位浅肤色年轻人物的胸上像，背后是深褐近黑的影棚底色。背景几乎空无一物，仅右侧一圈微弱暖色光晕将近侧肩膀与黑暗分开。人物位于中央，上身略向右转，目光直视观者。一顶宽大的奶油色布帽占据画面上方。低垂弯曲的帽檐镶米色边，层叠的蕾丝或刺绣花朵以浅色浮纹铺在帽冠上。柔软粉金色头发从帽檐两侧卷出，在颈旁收成松散的小卷。椭圆脸受到轻柔照明，眼睛清澈呈棕色，鼻子小巧，脸颊淡淡泛红，嘴角带轻微的闭口笑意。目光稳定而放松，下巴圆润细致。白色围巾或领巾在喉部折叠，垂在富有肌理的蕾丝领下。领上的细浅色环纹在深绿色衣服前鲜明可见。衣身铺过下半幅，布料有浅竖纹，中线留一道窄开口或扣饰。袖子与外侧肩膀大多被方形画框裁去。画面不见双手或道具。皮肤、蕾丝、头发和裙装均由受控的小笔触塑造，却呈现不同表面：平滑的皮肉、轻盈卷发、凸起蕾丝与哑光布料。深背景和紧密裁切使注意力落在平静五官以及围住脸部的浅色帽子与领子上。柔光似乎从左上前方进入，照亮额头、鼻子、面颊和帽檐，让颈侧和右肩留在轻柔阴影中。整体构图端庄和谐，以明亮奶油色和暖肤色平衡深绿与褐色阴影，形成安静的正式习作。
style_prompt_en: The finely finished oil painting uses smooth flesh-like modeling beside intricate pale textile texture and matte dark cloth. Cream, warm ivory, muted blush, deep green, and brown-black form a narrow harmonious palette. Gentle frontal side light makes the pale central planes luminous while the background recedes into velvety shadow. Curled and looped details are rendered with small precise strokes, but broad garment and ground areas stay quieter. Edges sharpen around the most illuminated features and soften in dark peripheral forms. A compact central arrangement and subdued halo create stillness without flattening the volumes. The overall effect is elegant and restrained, with delicate material contrasts carrying the visual interest.
style_prompt_zh: 这种精细完成的油画让平滑的肤感塑形与复杂浅色织物肌理、哑光深布料并置。奶油色、暖象牙白、低调腮红粉、深绿和褐黑构成范围收窄且和谐的配色。柔和的正面侧光使中央浅色平面发亮，背景退入绒质阴影。卷曲与环状细节由准确的小笔触表现，宽阔衣服和底面区域则保持安静。边缘在最亮的特征处清晰，在深色外围形体里柔化。紧凑中央布局与低调光晕带来静止感，却不压平体积。整体效果优雅克制，视觉兴趣来自细腻材料对比。
theme_en: A pale sitter in a lace-trimmed cream hat and dark green dress
theme_zh: 戴蕾丝边奶油色帽、穿深绿裙装的浅肤色人物
name: Pietro Antonio Rotari
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
